sql: SELECT j.email FROM ((SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, NULL AS email, sluice_src.tenant_id, sluice_src.created_at FROM shop.main.customers sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $1) c JOIN (SELECT * FROM shop.main.orders sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $2) o ON o.customer_id = c.id ) j
